description: Slash-command menu with a search input and grouped block-type items (plus an optional AI item), keyboard navigation, and recently-used tracking, raising item, AI, or close callbacks.

parameters.name: OnAISelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects the AI assistant action.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the user dismisses the menu (Escape / backdrop click).

parameters.name: OnItemSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a block type.

parameters.name: OnSlashItemSelected
parameters.description: Raised when the user selects a slash-menu item with item metadata.
